meta.title: Support for democracy
meta.question: Do Poles prefer democracy to any other form of government?
meta.measure: Average support for democracy as the best form of government, from 0 (another system can be better) to 10 (democracy is best)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on whether democracy is preferable to any other form of government, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: Democracy is better than any other form of government (agree-disagree)
items.notes: CBOS, 1992-09 to 2017-08, 34 surveys. Answer labels are either 'zdecydowanie tak ... nie' or 'zdecydowanie się zgadzam ... nie zgadzam'; both accepted. 1998-05 asked it on a 5-point scale with a middle 'i tak, i nie' (left out, one survey).

items.wording: For people like me it does not really matter whether government is democratic or not (agree-disagree; disagree = 10)
items.notes: CBOS, 1992-2017, 27 surveys. Linz's 'indifferent' item; agreement = indifference to regime type, so disagree = 10. 1993-06 2-point version left out.

items.wording: Sometimes non-democratic government can be preferable to democratic government (agree-disagree; disagree = 10)
items.notes: CBOS, 1992-2017, 26 surveys. Agreement = non-democratic rule acceptable, so disagree = 10. 1993-06 (2-point) and 1998-05 (5-point) versions left out.

items.wording: Democracy has its faults, but no better system than democracy has been invented (agree-disagree)
items.notes: CBOS, 1993-06 and 2001-06, 2 surveys. 'Demokracja ma swoje wady, ale lepszego systemu od demokracji nie wymyślono'; 1993 labels lack diacritics ('sie').

items.wording: Democracy may have problems but is better than any other form of government (agree-disagree)
items.notes: WVS 1997 only.

items.wording: Which is closest to your view: democracy is always best / non-democratic government is sometimes better / it makes no difference
items.notes: POLPAN 1998, 2003, 2008, 2013, 2018 (XJ11, WJ11, VJ03, UB03, TC04; one wide file, so the regex matches all five). Linz three-way item; 'makes no difference' = 5. 2013 (UB03) not asked in one questionnaire version (582 respondents). Labels: 1998 'Undemocratic rule sometimes better', 2003-13 'Non-democratic government is better', 2018 'sometimes better'.

items.wording: Having a democratic political system: very good ... very bad way of governing this country
Democracy may have problems but is better than any other form of government (agree-disagree)
items.notes: EVS 1999 and 2008 (Churchill item, 'Democracy may have problems but is better than any other form of government').

items.wording: Is democracy the best form of government, or would another be better? (best / undecided / other better)
items.notes: CDCEE March 2000 only (not asked in 1991). Undecided = 5.

items.wording: Democracy is preferable to any other kind of government (PGSW 2000)
items.notes: PGSW 2000 presidential study (bdemo107). Regex anchored on 'Q37.A' because Pew's 2015-16 religion survey (MISC, not to be used) has a similar Q12.

items.wording: To people like me it doesn't matter whether the government is democratic (PGSW 2000; disagree = 10)
items.notes: PGSW 2000 (nintd109).

items.wording: In certain situations an authoritarian government can be preferable (PGSW 2000; disagree = 10)
items.notes: PGSW 2000 (ndemo108).

items.wording: Democracy may have problems but is better than any other form of government (agree-disagree)
items.notes: PGSW 2001-2019, 6 surveys. dem_best_w2 (2005 wave II) left out.

items.wording: For people like me it does not matter whether a government is democratic (agree-disagree; disagree = 10)
Sometimes a non-democratic government can be preferable (agree-disagree; disagree = 10)
Having a democratic political system: very good ... very bad way of governing this country
items.notes: WVS 2005 and 2012 (not asked in Poland in 1997).

items.wording: Democracy is not a good system, admittedly, but there is no better one (agree-disagree)
items.notes: CBOS, 2006-11 to 2015-11, 12 surveys. 'Demokracja nie jest wprawdzie dobrym ustrojem, ale nie ma ustroju lepszego'.

items.wording: A democratic political system: a very good ... very bad way of governing Poland
items.notes: PGSW 2015 only (WVS regime battery).

items.wording: A democratic system where representatives elected by citizens decide what becomes law: very good ... very bad way of governing
items.notes: Pew 2017, 2023, 2024 (Polish n about 1,000 each). Representative democracy as a way of governing.

items.wording: A democratic political system: very good ... very bad (online)
items.notes: SWPS COVID tracker (online), waves 3, 5, 9 (2020-21).

items.wording: Democracy has problems but is a better system of government than any other (online)
items.notes: SWPS COVID tracker (online), waves 4-6, 8-13, 15 (2020-21), 10 surveys.

items.wording: Democracy is better than any other form of government (CBOS democracy survey, 2021)
items.notes: CBOS democracy survey, c. 2021 (q69).

items.wording: For people like me it does not matter whether government is democratic (CBOS 2021; disagree = 10)
items.notes: CBOS democracy survey, c. 2021 (q70).

items.wording: Sometimes non-democratic government can be preferable (CBOS 2021; disagree = 10)
items.notes: CBOS democracy survey, c. 2021 (q71).

items.wording: Democracy is always and in all circumstances better than any other system of government (agree-disagree, 5-point)
items.notes: PGSW 2023 only; 5-point and 'always and in all circumstances', so its own item.
